title: Large-scale single-cell cloning of genome-edited cultured human cells by On-chip SPiS
protocol: Cover a single well of a 12-well plate with 500 μL of Matrigel solution.
Incubate the 12-well plate at 37°C for at least 1 hour to coat the plate.
Detach HEK293T cells with 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA.
Count the cell number.
Remove Matrigel solution from the 12-well plate.
Seed HEK293T cells at 2×10^5 cells/well.
Incubate in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator overnight (12–24 hours).
Adjust the DNA concentration of px458-HypaCas9 in water to 1,000 ng/μL.
Adjust the donor DNA concentration to 100 ng/μL.
Prepare Mixture 1 and Mixture 2 by pipetting as shown in the provided tables.
Add 40 μL/well of Mixture 1.
Add 40 μL/well of Mixture 2.
Mix well.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 min.
Drip 80 μL/well of the incubated solution onto HEK293T cells in a 12-well plate.
Observe the fluorescence of the transfected wells the next day.
Add 30 μl/well of Matrigel solution to a 96-well plate.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator overnight (3–24 h).
Remove the growth medium from the cells.
Wash the cells once with 1 mL PBS.
Detach the HEK293T cells from a 12-well plate using 200 μL/well of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA for 3 min at 37°C.
Add 800 μL/well of growth medium to resuspend detached cells by gentle pipetting.
Collect the cell suspension in a 1.5-mL tube and centrifuge at 280 × g for 3 min at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant using a pipette.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 350 μL of fresh growth medium.
Select the “OnChipFlow/Sort” icon to start the sorting control software program.
Create a sample sheet after logging in.
Set the accuracy adjustment chip (sealed hole) shown in Figure 2C in the chip holder and insert it into the main sorter unit.
Perform “Auto Check line” with an adjustment chip for fine tuning to maintain sorting accuracy.
Select “OK” when a dialog box appears.
Set the new chip in the chip holder.
Add 8.0 mL of sheath liquid (On-chip T-Buffer) to the Sheath Reservoir.
Add 1.7 mL of On-chip T-Buffer to the Sorting Reservoir.
Add 500 μL of On-chip T-Buffer to the Collection Reservoir, leaving about 50 μL in it after cleaning.
Add 500 μL of sample solution to the Sample Reservoir.
Select "Prime" in the “Operation controls” panel to clean the microfluidic lines.
Transfer 150 μL of cell suspension to a new 1.5-mL tube.
Add 50 μL of T-Buffer to the cell suspension in the tube.
Transfer the full volume of the cell suspension to the sample reservoir.
Set the chip holder containing the cell suspension into the main sorter unit.
Select "Run" in the “Operation controls” panel to start pre-sorting.
Sort for about 10–30 seconds, and then select “Stop”.
Check the plots displayed in "Work space".
Identify the cell population by gating it.
Adjust the sorting rate to a maximum of 30 events/sec; dilute with T-Buffer if necessary.
After setting up the gates, select "Sorting" from the "Operation Control" panel.
Collect 2,000 cells after setting up the sorting parameters.
Transfer collected cells to a new 1.5-mL tube.
Add T-Buffer up to 300 μL in the new tube containing the sorted cells.
Turn on the SPiS unit and a connected computer.
Launch the software program to control the SPiS.
Input the information of the plate into which cells are dispensed.
Select "ORG" in the operation screen panel.
Set the pipetting system at the initial position in the SPiS.
Perform “Automatic dilution” with the SPiS.
Place a 1.5-mL tube containing cell suspension from step 5b-xi in position 1.
Place a 1.5-mL tube containing 300 μL of PBS (for waste) in position 3.
Place an empty 1.5 mL tube in position 5.
Place a 5 mL flat bottom tube containing 5 mL of PBS in position 6.
Select "Automatic dilution" in the “Menu Item” and enter settings: Number of Times: 10, Number of Cells: 1, Histogram Class: 100.
Check the histogram and select "Proceed".
Transfer the diluted cell suspension from the empty tube at position 5 to position 1.
Remove the Matrigel from the 96-well plate (step 3b) and place it in the plate holder of the SPiS.
Select “Pre Dispensing” in the operation panel.
Dispense 30 μL of PBS into each well of the 96-well plate.
Pre-dispense PBS into a 96-well plate manually.
Select "START" from the menu screen to begin dispensing single cells with SPiS.
Prepare the second 96-well plate and start dispensing once the first plate is finished.
Start preparing the third and fourth 96-well plates while dispensing continues on the second plate.
Return to step 4 after completing two plates for cell sorting and single-cell dispensing.
Add 100 μL/well of pre-warmed conditioned medium using a multichannel pipette after single-cell dispensing.
Replace culture medium with growth medium weekly.
Remove medium in 96-well plates two weeks post-dispensing.
Wash once with 100 μL/well of PBS.
Detach survived cells with 10 μL/well of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA.
Add 100 μL of growth medium 2 to resuspend cells in the same plate.
Keep culturing the cells until they become confluent.
Transfer established clones into 12- or 6-well plates for expanded culture.
Extract genomic DNA from a portion of the detached cells when transferring to expanded culture.
Incubate the cells overnight at 55°C in cell lysis buffer containing 10 mM Tris pH7.5, 10 mM EDTA, 10 mM NaCl, 0.5% N-Lauroylsarcosine, and 0.1 mg/mL Proteinase K.
Perform genomic DNA extraction using ethanol precipitation after the incubation.
Alternatively, use the rapid extraction method with Alkaline lysis solution (HoTSHOT method) for genomic DNA extraction.
Analyze genome editing results of clones by common polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and/or Sanger sequencing.
Perform multiplexed amplicon sequencing to genotype many clones.
